title: Project route canary outages as a first-class Nostr fleet-health observable
problem: Route outage state was exposed only through the REST API and in-process events (route.canary_outage_opened, route.canary_recovered, route.canary_classification_changed). Nothing projected it to Nostr, and fleet-health classification in internal/adapters/telemetry/nostr_fleet_health.go had no route domain, so a route outage was invisible to Nostr-native consumers, dashboards and the bahia_fleet_health_nostr_entities gauge. Separately, the inbound subscriber skipped all handlers for already-persisted events, and because the publisher persists every signed event before its relay attempt, fleet-health telemetry never observed any Bahia-published observable, including the existing runtime managed-instance projection.
observed_behavior: internal/service/route_canary.go publishes RouteCanaryChanged on the in-process bus only; no subscriber projected it to Nostr.
boundedFleetDomain accepted only agent, worker, service, deployment, runtime, relay, control_plane; renderNostrFleetHealthMetrics used a separate hardcoded copy of that list.

Subscriber.handleEvent returned before invoking handlers when eventRepo.Record reported inserted=false; Publisher.PublishSignedEventWithResults records into the same repository before publishing, so self-published echoes were always inserted=false.
intended_behavior: Every route canary transition is projected to existing canonical kinds under domain=route: 30315 status and 30900 state addressed by the route coordinate, and a 4903 audit fact per transition. Each carries a truthful bounded fleet-health status, the outage state, the classification, the observed container status and the service_healthy_route_broken contrast. Fleet-health telemetry counts route entities under a distinct route domain (one per route coordinate), treats route audit facts as lineage, and observes Bahia's own relay echoes so the gauge counts them.

in: internal/app/app.go (projector wiring, telemetry registered as observer)
docs listed in AGENTS.md for Nostr event changes, fleet-health.md, route-canaries.md Events and alerting section
out: RouteCanaryGate (records outcomes without publishing in-process events)
Fleet-health telemetry hydration from relay history on restart
